cat > /workspace/tmp/find_zero_cycle.py <<'PY'
import random,importlib.util,time,itertools
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(s)
random.seed(12345)
start=time.time()
for trial in range(200000):
    k=random.randint(3,12)
    cp={}
    # generate random simple paths that are consecutive arcs on the cycle, possibly reversed
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,20)):
        a=random.randrange(k); L=random.randint(2,k)
        verts=[]; step=random.choice([1,-1])
        for j in range(L): verts.append(1+((a+step*j)%k))
        p=tuple(verts)
        if len(set(p))<L: continue
        cp[p]=cp.get(p,0)+random.randint(1,5)
    rounds,cur,core=s.peel(cp)
    if rounds: continue
    edges=sorted(core)
    if not(1<=len(edges)<=12): continue
    ei={e:i for i,e in enumerate(edges)}
    sc,occ=s.build_scopes_and_occurrences(cur,ei)
    fac=s.make_factors(len(edges),sc,occ)
    # use a min-degree order to compute Z quickly/accurately even if width bad
    m=len(edges); left=set(range(m)); pos=[0]*m
    adj=[set() for _ in range(m)]
    for scope in sc:
        x=list(scope)
        for i in range(len(x)):
            for j in range(i+1,len(x)):
                adj[x[i]].add(x[j]);adj[x[j]].add(x[i])
    for pp in range(m):
        v=min(left,key=lambda z:len(adj[z]));left.remove(v);pos[v]=pp
        ne=list(adj[v])
        for i in range(len(ne)):
            for j in range(i+1,len(ne)):
                adj[ne[i]].add(ne[j]);adj[ne[j]].add(ne[i])
        for y in ne:adj[y].discard(v)
        adj[v].clear()
    Z=s.run_ve(fac,m,pos)
    if Z==0:
        print('FOUND trial',trial,'k',k,'cp',cp,'edges',edges,'sc',sc,'occ',occ,flush=True)
        print('elapsed',time.time()-start);break
else:
    print('none',time.time()-start)
PY
